SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver, r.name AS race, lt.time, lt.milliseconds
FROM lapTimes lt JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = lt.driverId JOIN races r ON r.raceId = lt.raceId
ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC LIMIT 5;

Note the pitfall: NULL milliseconds sorts first in ASC in SQLite. Use WHERE lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL.

input.sql:
SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver, r.name AS race, r.year, lt.time, lt.milliseconds
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
JOIN races r ON r.raceId = lt.raceId
WHERE lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 10;
